alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein was reduced and alkylated by 5mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine hydrochloride (TCEP) and 5mM chloroacetamide for 1 hour at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Lys-C was added (1/200 w:w) and the protein digested for 2–4 hours at 37°C, the protein was further diluted to 1M GuHCl, before digesting with trypsin protease (1/200 w:w) overnight at 37°C.
